root_cause: Browser multipart revision is a string. Laravel integer validation did not cast it; strict comparison with integer workspace revision always rejected equal values. Original PHP helper hid transport difference.
reproduction_before_fix: Realistic string multipart preview returned 409 at revision 0 in regression test
fix: Normalize validated multipart revision to integer
Preview current locked master and return current revision
Commit must match inspected revision; no automatic write retry over a conflict
Confirmed 409 clears preview, retains selected file and requests inspection again
Network uncertainty preserves hash/file/UUID retry identity

supplied_workbook.verification: Parsed and upsert-previewed in isolated SQLite memory, no live import

query_review: Recover revision through the existing preview response; no extra catalog/state request. Existing 2/3 template query budgets still pass.
limitations: No live batch import or concurrent load test
